I bought a Glorious Asus VG248QE Gaming Monitor even though people complained about washed out colors. There's a fix, and it only took me 10 minutes. Here's how - mirror

Such a pain and I never did bother looking it up because I discovered in my own messing around that if you use Windows Monitor Calibration (rclick destkop -> screen resolution -> make text and other items appear larger or smaller -> Calibrate Color, or control panel -> display -> calibrate color) and set the gamma to it's lowest setting and skip everything else (may want to take out some blue actually) it looks great! The problem with this method is that windows absolutely sucks at remembering those calibrations and anything from restarting or launching a game fucks them up again. The OSD for that monitor does not have a gamma setting so I never bothered to look further into that option. Suggestions are welcome!
